titleEn: The Employee That Worked on the Longest Task
title: 处理用时最长的任务的员工
summary: 任务按结束时间记录员工编号，每个任务紧接前一个开始，返回单次任务用时最长且编号最小的员工。
insight: 当前任务时长为结束时间减前一任务结束时间，逐项比较时长，平局取较小员工编号。
pitfalls: 比较单次任务而非员工总时长

solutions.title: 结束时间差扫描
solutions.idea: 滚动上一结束时刻并维护最优员工。
steps: 更长或同长员工更小时更新

code.java: class Solution { public int hardestWorker(int n,int[][] logs){int previous=0,best=-1,answer=n;for(int[] log:logs){int duration=log[1]-previous;if(duration>best||duration==best&&log[0]<answer){best=duration;answer=log[0];}previous=log[1];}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun hardestWorker(n:Int,logs:Array<IntArray>):Int{var previous=0;var best=-1;var answer=n;for(log in logs){val duration=log[1]-previous;if(duration>best||duration==best&&log[0]<answer){best=duration;answer=log[0]};previous=log[1]};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int hardestWorker(int n,vector<vector<int>>& logs){int previous=0,best=-1,answer=n;for(auto& log:logs){int duration=log[1]-previous;if(duration>best||(duration==best&&log[0]<answer)){best=duration;answer=log[0];}previous=log[1];}return answer;} };
